answer: Price influence by weight squared, not by head. The node charges every attester a gale fee: to cast k attestations in an epoch, an identity must burn k-squared units from a locked jade deposit that only genuine earned reputation can refresh. One honest agent barely feels the burn; a farmer spreading a fleet thin wants k times the voice from each clone, so the collateral each account must carry grows quadratically with its output. No voyage through this ledger is cheap for a swarm: every clone pays its own burn or the farm pays the square.
